text: NEW CORESTA TASK FORCES ON ENVIRONMENTAL ISSUES
Task Force for Determination of Chemical Constituents in Tobacco Factory Emissions and Liquid
Objective: Develop methods for the determination of specific chemical constituents in
atmospheric emissions and liquid effluents of tobacco factories.
• Task Force for Determination of Physical Aspects of Tobacco Factory Emissions
Objective: Develop methods for measuring atmospheric tobacco dust and noise.
Task Force on Disposal of Waste Tobacco Dust
Objective: Determine the most efficient means for the disposal of waste tobacco dust.
